items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 41:1
items.html: (To the question) For their vessels broke and fell to BYA; therefore they drew as close to them as they could, in order to illuminate them in the phase of crowns [Tagin] upon the letters. (p. 554, Item 20)
